text:
Aria: Lost mug report — blue ceramic mug that says 'world's okayest engineer' on the rim. Last seen on the 2nd-floor kitchen counter ~10:15. If you grabbed it by accident please drop it on the 'lost mug' shelf or ping me. :pleading_face:
Devon: Not me. That's my old mug's twin though. We call that model 'Cobalt Mutiny' in the lore.
Samir: I may have seen a suspicious paper bag headed toward Meeting Room B at 10:30. Silhouette looked very much like 'coffee thief' (no judgment).
Priya: Was it labelled 'For Devon'? I've been doing mug policing this week. I'll check the bag and the lost shelf now.
OpsBot: Camera motion detected in kitchen at 10:27 — clip available (link). For privacy reasons, full footage requests need manager approval.
Devon: Link please. I will stage a formal reclamation ceremony. Prepare chants and a sticker.
Aria: Devon you're not allowed to do ceremonies without the consenting mug. :laughing: But seriously thanks Priya, appreciate the hunt.
Samir: If we don't find it by Friday we institute the "Mug Replacement Fund" — everyone chips $5, we buy a ceremonial replacement engraved 'Returned by Fate'.
Priya: Quick poll: 1) Return by Friday (I check), 2) Replace w/ new 'Cobalt Mutiny' (group fund), 3) Offer penance (sing at all-hands). Vote pls.
Devon: Vote: Return by Friday. If not returned, penance accepted but only if the song is about caching.
Aria: Extra ID note: mug has a tiny chip on the bottom and a duck sticker near the handle. Should help.
Samir: Update: checked Meeting Room B bag. Found two tupperwares and a scarf. No mug. :detective:
OpsBot: Lost & Found shelf updated at 11:03 — photo posted in #kitchen-ops and tag applied: #mugs.
Priya: FOUND IT! It was hiding on the back of the fridge magnet behind a meetup flyer. Devon, I am personally returning your mug to your desk. :raised_hands::sparkles:
Devon: Blessed be the return. Ceremony cancelled. Small bow. :bowing_man:
Aria: Huge kudos to Priya the Mug Whisperer — coffee and a sticker to you. :coffee: :trophy:
Samir: Lore update: This shall henceforth be known as the "Cobalt Mutiny — Fridge Edition." Sticker suggestion: a tiny duck with a magnifying glass.
Devon: Accepting sticker designs. Also adding 'pride of fridge retrieval' as a rite of passage for new hires.
Priya: I'll make a tiny sticker draft. Also tagging OpsBot to remind new hires about the lost & found during onboarding.
OpsBot: Noted — onboarding checklist updated with 'lost mug etiquette'.
Aria: Thread closed. Thanks team!
